observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Canon DSLR camera with a lens attached. The lens barrel has '18-55mm' printed on it. The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS 800D' visible. The lens cap is on, showing 'Canon' branding.
Photo 1: Back view of the camera, showing the LCD screen, control buttons, and the rear grip. The camera body has 'Canon' branding. The lens is attached, and the screen is off.

Photo 2: Front view of the camera, similar to photo 0, with the lens cap on. The lens barrel shows '18-55mm' and 'Canon' branding. The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS 800D' visible. The lens cap is on.
All photos show the camera held in hand, with a glass display cabinet and boxes of Canon and Nikon cameras in the background.
The lens appears to be a standard 18-55mm kit lens, commonly used with Canon DSLRs.
The camera body shows no visible damage or major wear in the photos, but no close-up of the sensor, buttons, or screen is provided.

claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: The model 'EOS 800D' is visible on the camera body in photos 0 and 2. The lens '18-55mm' is visible on the lens barrel in photos 0 and 2. However, 'Neat UK used' cannot be verified from the photos alone; no proof of origin or condition beyond appearance.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera turning on, screen displaying, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or fungus not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front and rear elements, under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens may be damaged

risks.risk: Sensor may be scratched or dirty
risks.proof: Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed, or a close-up of the sensor under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor may be damaged

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger, or a video showing the camera powering on with battery.
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery and charger may be missing

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the camera turning on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front and rear elements.
Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed.
Photo of the battery and charger.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
